reason: B is the better proposal because a continuous refractory Nb interlayer can plausibly act directly as a kinetic diffusion barrier without requiring oxygen to reach a buried interface, whereas A’s proposed in-situ alumina layer is unlikely to form uniformly beneath intact Cr and may introduce Al–Zr reactions. B remains weakened by the inaccurate claim of low Nb–Zr mutual solubility, absent supporting evidence, and unspecified exposure durations, so its barrier performance requires direct validation.
